text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Today is Nozomi's last day working at the Alkes Alchemy Hall. Early in the morning, {0} spots Nozomi heading to the alchemy pot in the workshop and calls out to her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はノゾミがアルケス錬金堂で働く最後の日。
{0}は早朝の工房で、
錬金釜に向かうノゾミを見つけ声をかけた。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ah, good morning... AAAHHH, stop! Don't come near me until I'm wearing my mask!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
おはよー
……
っと、
ストップ！
マスクするまで近づかないでっ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yeah... But I still haven't drunk it yet. There's something I want to do while I'm still sensitive to smells.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
でもまだ飲んでないの。
匂いに敏感なうちにやりたいことがあったから。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I want to make perfume in return for everyone's kindness! The best perfume ever for everyone, proof tested by a smell fetishist!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私ね……
みんなへの恩返しに、
香水を作りたいの！
匂いフェチの匂いフェチによる、
みんなのための最高の香水を！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: So I thought I'd drink it after I finished making the perfume. But it didn't go so well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから
香水を完成させてからにしようかなって。
でも、
なかなか上手くいかなくって……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I've tried a lot of different things, like citrus notes of bergamot and lime, fruity notes, gourmand notes... and I've come up with something pretty good.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん。
ベルガモットや
ライムの柑橘系や、
フルーティ系、
グルマン系……
いろいろ試して、
結構いい感じのとこまではできてるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: But I feel like I'm missing something... Like a secret ingredient in cooking? I don't have enough hidden flavorings, so to speak.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
何か一つ足りない気がして……
お料理の隠し味的な？　
言うなれば
隠し香料が足りないの。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Hmph.
text_block_list.orig_text: フンね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Lou-chan?! Oh damn, I wanted to keep it a secret, but she found out! And I was even so careful not to make a sound~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルイちゃんっ！？
あちゃ、
内緒にしときたかったのにバレちゃった！
せっかく音立てないように気を付けてたのに～

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I mean, if you're scattering such a smell everywhere anyone would notice even without you knowing, Nozomi.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや
こんなに匂い撒き散らかしてるんだから。
ノゾミじゃなくても気付くわよ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha, I see. By the way, Lou-chan, what did you say just a moment ago?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あはは、
そっか。
ところでルイちゃん、
さっき
何か言った？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Hmph.
text_block_list.orig_text: フン。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Eeehhhh? I thought we'd finally gotten to know each other better, but you're already back to the tsun-tsun Lou-chan now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ～
せっかく仲良くなれたと思ったのに、
またツンツンルイちゃんに戻っちゃった～？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: No, I wasn't trying to smirk! "Hmph" I said, "hmph"! P-O-O-P!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや鼻で笑ったんじゃないから！
フンよフン！　
う・
ん・
ち！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Huh? Poop?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
うんち？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Someone got lured in by the word "poop"!
text_block_list.orig_text: うんちに釣られて入ってきた！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but this child is currently experiencing an unprecedented poop boom right now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめん、
今この子の中で
空前のうんちブーム到来してるから。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: What's with that, you're just a kid...
text_block_list.orig_text: なにそれ子どもじゃん……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: But I'm the kid?
text_block_list.orig_text: 子どもだよ？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Hey, everyone, you're all being so vulgar! ...Lou-chan, what did you mean by "Hmph" then?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
みんな下品だよ！？
……
ルイちゃん
フンってどういうこと？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Nozomi you just mentioned it yourself: "There's one thing missing". And that missing material for perfume is animal poop.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ノゾミが言ったんじゃない、
なにか一つ足りないって。
香水に足りない素材は、
動物のフンってことよ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...An animal poop? Ah... Now that I think about it, I think I've heard that somewhere before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……動物のフンが？
あ……
そういえば
何かで聞いたことあるかも。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: It has a strong, pungent smell on its own, but by mixing it with a tiny amount of a sweet scent, it brings out the sweetness. I see... it really does feel like a "hidden fragrance"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それ単体ではきつい刺激臭だけど、
甘い香りに極微量混ぜることによって、
香りを引き立たせるんだよね。
そうか……
まさに隠し香料って感じだね！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: All right, let's see what kind of animal's poop is the best here, and find out where it's from... ...But before that... Lou-chan. Are we really, um, going to use poop...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
何の動物のフンがいいのか、
その生息地も調べて……
……
っと。
その前に……
ルイちゃん。
本当に、
その、
フンを
使うの……？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: That's right. Or so I'd like to say, but... To be precise, it's a crystal that has created itself from aging poop. Well...that's beside the point.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうよ。
って
言いたいところだけど……
正確には
フンが経年変化した結晶だったりするわね。
ま……
それはそれとして。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: You want to make the best perfume, don't you? Didn't you say you weren't satisfied with the common ingredients in normal perfumes?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなた、
最高の香水を作りたいんだよね。
ふつうの香水でも使われる香料で満足なの？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Of course, I want to make something special, but... Lou-chan, do you have any ideas...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは、
もちろん、
特別なものが作りたいけど……
ルイちゃん
何か考えが……？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: It's very simple. You just need to use rare materials that you can't normally get your hands on. You already know where I'm going with this... "Not an animal".
text_block_list.orig_text:
簡単よ。
ふつうじゃ手に入らない、
希少な素材を使えばいいの。
もう分かるでしょ……
動物じゃなくって。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Got it! You want me to use a monster's poop!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……分かった！
魔物のフンかな！？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Correct-a-mundo. Well then, let's hurry up and gather some materials!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そゆこと。
じゃ、
サクッと素材集めに行くわよ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃああ～～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Lou-chan, get back. Iroha, I'm counting on you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルイちゃん下がりな。
頼んだ
イロハ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!! DORYAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お任せ！！
どりゃあっ！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: ルイズマリー
text_block_list.text:
はあ、
イロハちゃんありがと。
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ、
イロハちゃんありがと。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... There's still a long way to go. The monster we're looking for lives in the deepest part of this cave. ...Well, that is only IF we can get there to begin with.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう……
まだまだ先は長いよ。
お目当ての魔物が生息してるのは
この洞窟の一番奥だからね。
……
ま、
たどり着ければの話だけど。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Hey, Sono-san. Don't scare me like that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
ソノさん。
怖がらせないでよ……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...I heard from Karin before we came here. It seems a lot of adventurers have tried to explore this cave, but not a single one has made it all the way to the very innermost part...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ここに来る前、
カリンさんに聞いたんだけどね。
多くの冒険者が
この洞窟に挑戦したみたいだけど、
最奥まで到達できた冒険者は
一人もいないらしいわ……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Because apparently there is a terrifying monster nesting there. A giant snake-type monster...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なぜなら
とてつもなく凶悪な魔物が
巣くっているからだそうよ。
巨大な
ヘビ型の魔物がね……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Huh? A giant snake-type monster?! ...Is that thing really strong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ
巨大なヘビ型の魔物！？
……
そいつって強いのかな？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Don't get excited right away. ... It seems to be a subspecies of the Sword Cobra, but its ferocity is several dozen times greater. Even though a request for its extermination has been made, it has not yet been fulfilled...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ワクワクしてんじゃないわよ。
……
ソードコブラの亜種らしいんだけど、
その凶悪さは何十倍。
討伐依頼が出されても
未だ達成されてないって……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Its name is "Venom Hydra" and it apparently spits poisonous gas that paralyzes the nerves.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……名前は
『ヴェノム・ヒュドラ』
神経をマヒさせる毒ガスを吐くらしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone, let's go home after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……みんな、
やっぱり帰ろう。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I'm glad you're willing to help, but I can't expose everyone to danger because of my selfishness...
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかく協力してくれるのはうれしいけど、
私のわがままで
みんなを危険な目には晒せないから……

text_block_list.name: Venom Hydra
text_block_list.text: Kishaaaa!!
text_block_list.orig_text: キシャアアア！！

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: IT'S HEREEEEE!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 出たーーーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, there's an alchemy item for times like these! Set the item...! Here I go, spraying tear gas ACTIVATE!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……フン、
こういう時のために錬金アイテムがあるのよ！
アイテムをセットして……！
いくわよ
催涙ガス噴射ーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Venom Hydra
text_block_list.text: Kishaaaa!!
text_block_list.orig_text: キシャアアア！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: What?! It's not working at all?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっ！？
全然効いてない！？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Yes! Iroha can explain! Snakes detect prey with sensors called pit organs! That's why it doesn't matter if their eyesight is blocked off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は
いっ！　
イロハわかるよ！
ヘビは
ピット器官っていうセンサーで獲物を感知するの！
だから
視力が封じられても関係ないんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Also! Snakes can't close their eyes because they don't have eyelids! But apparently they still sleep! And, also, also...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あとね！　
ヘビはまぶたがないから
目を閉じられないんだよ！
でもちゃんと眠るんだってさ！　
あとねあとね！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Why did you suddenly flipped on the switch to tell us random trivia?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで今
雑学言いたいスイッチ入れた？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...! Another monster's approaching...! We're now caught into a pincer attack...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！　
また別の魔物が……！
挟み撃ちにされた……っ！！

text_block_list.name: Venom Hydra
text_block_list.text: Worororo......pushaa!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ウォロロロ……プシャアッ！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Eeek, I feel so sick I'm about to throw up!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひいっ、
なんか吐き出した気持ち悪っ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: To steal the freedom of that other large monster in an instant... So this is the poison gas that has defeated all the adventurers so far...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんな大型の魔物の自由を
一瞬で奪うなんて……
これが今まで冒険者たちを返り討ちにした毒ガスか……！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone, leave this to me and run away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……みんな、
ここは私に任せて逃げて！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...I won't let anyone lay a hand on you...! I will protect everyone even if it costs me my life...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……みんなに手出しはさせない……！
私が命に替えてもみんなを守る……！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: MY BELOVED... FELLOW MEMBERS OF ALKES ALCHEMY HALL!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大好きな
【アルケス錬金堂】のみんなを！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...I won't let you be the only one to show off today, Nozomi! I'll protect you too... Because you... you're my...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ノゾミにだけかっこつけさせないわ！
あなたは私が守る……
だってあなたは私の……！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: BECAUSE YOU'RE MY PRECIOUS FIRST DISCIPLE!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の
大切な一番弟子だから！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Lou-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text: ルイちゃんっ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Nozomi!
text_block_list.orig_text: ノゾミっ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, hey. I'm sorry for ruining the climatic moment, but look...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ちょいちょい。
エモいとこ申し訳ないんだけど、
あれ。

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Hm?
text_block_list.orig_text: ん？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Here I go. Iroha's special...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いくよ。
イロハのとっておき……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: ...Haahh!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……はああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Isurugi Style Secret Technique: Iroha's Song [Amber]
text_block_list.orig_text:
『イスルギ流奥義・
いろは歌
【琥珀】』

text_block_list.name: Venom Hydra
text_block_list.text: Kishaaaa!?
text_block_list.orig_text: キシャアアァァ～～ッ！？

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: DOWN IN ONE HITTTTTT!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 瞬殺ーーーっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: It's okay. Don't worry, that was merely the first hit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫。
安心してよ
峰打ちだから。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: I mean, if it dies, we won't be able to play anymore. Then... let's go for a second round, okay?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって死んじゃったら、遊べないもんね。
じゃあ
二回戦目、
やろっか。

text_block_list.name: Venom Hydra
text_block_list.text: Ki... Kishaaaa!!
text_block_list.orig_text: キ……キシャアアア～～～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: T-That monster ran away with all its might... Or rather, Iroha-chan, that's you right? You're somehow more cool and serious than usual...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぜ、
全力で逃げてった……
というか
イロハちゃん、
だよね？
なんかクールでかっこいい……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry, sorry. When I pull out my sword, my personality changes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っとごめんごめん。
オレ、剣抜くと人格変わっちゃうからさ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Even your voice has gotten cooler...
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレ
って──
声もかっこいい……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Are you hurt, Nozomi? I'll protect you. I won't let anyone lay a finger on you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
怪我はないか
ノゾミ……
お前はオレが守るから。
お前には、
指一本触れさせねえ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Come on, Nozomi. I'll cover you in my embrace.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
おいでよノゾミ。
オレが抱きしめてやるから。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ugh... This is bad... So cool... Iroha-chan, don't tell me... If you pull out your sword, you'll stop being a kid...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう……
やばい、
かっこいい……
イロハちゃん、まさか。
まさか剣を抜くとオレっ子に……？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: That's how it is.
text_block_list.orig_text: そういうこと。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, that's a total lie, you know? If we also add that your personality changes when the sword is drawn it'll overlap with our body switch situation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
めちゃくちゃ嘘だよ？
体入れ替わってて、
刀抜くと人格変わるって
設定が多すぎる。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Teheh.
text_block_list.orig_text: てへ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: You tricked me!
text_block_list.orig_text: 騙された！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, having escaped the crisis and obtained rare monster poop in the deepest parts, the group returned to the Alchemy shop.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして危機を脱し、
最奥で希少な魔物のフンを手に入れた一行は、
錬金堂の工房へと帰ってきた。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: "Original Transmutation"!
text_block_list.orig_text: 『基創錬成』！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Alright, it's done! It's the best perfume I've ever smelled! Let's give it a try, everyone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
完成！
匂いフェチも思わず唸る最高の香水だよ！
試しにみんな嗅いでみて！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Let me see, let me see.
text_block_list.orig_text: どれどれ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: *sniff sniff*...
text_block_list.orig_text: クンクン……っ。

text_block_list.name: Alkes Alchemy Hall
text_block_list.text: Oooh~♪

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: It smells so good! I could smell it forever! I can understand how the stag beetles feel as they swarm around the sap♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
すっ
ごくいい匂いっ！　
ずっと嗅いでられるっ！
樹液に群がるクワガタの気持ちがわかる～♪

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: A unique impression... but it really does smell amazing. ...That's it, if we were to sell this as a special Nozomi branded perfume... hehehe
text_block_list.orig_text:
独特な感想……
でも、
本当にすっごくいい匂いね。
……
そうだ
ノゾミ印の特製香水として売り出せば……
ふふふ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Now I've been able to leave behind what I learned here and also the culmination of this condition. ...I have no regrets anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ。
ここで学んだことと、
この体質の集大成が残せた。
……
これで思い残すことはないよ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Then I'll drink the miracle cure for my smell fetish.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……じゃあ、
匂いフェチが治る特効薬、
飲むね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Gulp.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ごくん。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: *sniff sniff*... Yeah, I think it's getting better...! But now that I'm even more aware of it, I think I still like your smell after all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
クンクンクン……
うん、
治ってる、
と思う……！
自覚しちゃったから
やっぱりキミの匂いは好きなまんまだけど……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: N-NO SHAMELESSNESS!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
破廉恥っ！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Lou-chan, truly thank you so much. Now all my fans won't know how embarrassing I can be.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ルイちゃん、
本当にありがとう。
これで私の恥ずかしい姿、
ファンのみんなにバレなくて済むよ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I-I'm glad. ...But I don't think you really need to worry about that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
良かったわね。
……
でも私は、
そんなこと気にする必要ないと思うけど。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Even if you have some flaws to yourself, it's still fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいじゃん、
ちょっとくらいダメなところがあっても、
さ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Your smell fetish is just like the "monster's poop" present in this new perfume.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたの匂いフェチは
この香水の、
『魔物のフン』みたいなものよ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Wh-What I'm about to say is a clear lie, but still pay attention...! Nozomi, you're cute, cheerful, innocent, and honest... You have so many good points to you that it's frustrating. However...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
今から言うことは全部嘘だけど聞きなさい……！
ノゾミは
かわいくて、
明るくて、
天真爛漫で、
素直で……
悔しいほどいい所をいっぱい持ってる。
でもさ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: However, a person only made of good points would be no fun at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
いい所しかない人なんて、
面白くないわ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: That's why you shouldn't be ashamed to have a bit of weirdness to your person, it's nice. That'd make your good sides stand out more. ...Remember that this is a lie, tough.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
ちょっとくらい変なとこあった方がステキ。
その方が、
あなたのいい所が引き立つじゃない。
……
嘘だけど。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That's a nice thing to say. A smell fetish is definitely a “monster's poop” that brings out Nozomi-chan’s good points.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいこと言うじゃん。
たしかに匂いフェチは、
ノゾミちゃんのいいとこを引き立たせる
『魔物のフン』だね。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Yeah!! Sniff sniff shameless mode Nozomi-chan is also quite lovable and funny!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ！！
クンクンって
破廉恥モードのノゾミちゃん、
面白くって大好きっ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Everyone... Hehehe♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな……
ふふふ♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Then I suppose Lou-chan's delusional tendencies are also her own's "monster's poop", right♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ
ルイちゃんの妄想癖も、
『魔物のフン』だね♪

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はあっ！？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Also, her foul mouth, her quickness to get carried away, her lack of enthusiasm, her stubbornness, her fickleness, her weakness in the mornings, and her tendency to be very opinionated are all Lou-chan's "monster poop"♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あと
口が悪いとこと、
すぐ調子に乗るとこと、
ノリが悪いとこと、
素直じゃないとこと、
ちょろいとこと、
朝が弱いとこと、
思い込みが激しいとこも
ルイちゃんの『魔物のフン』だよね♪

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: WAIT, ISN'T THAT TOO MUCH POOP?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと
フン多くないかしら！！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Fufu. But there's an even larger quantity of good sides to you, that's why you're so charming Lou-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ。
それ以上にいい所がいっぱいあるから、
ルイちゃんは魅力的なんだよ。

text_block_list.name: ルイズマリー
text_block_list.text: 今のプロポーズっ！！？
text_block_list.orig_text: 今のプロポーズっ！！？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Whoa! She went red and collapsed?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ！　
顔真っ赤にして倒れちゃった！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: It seems she let out one of her "poop" sides fast.
text_block_list.orig_text:
早速出したな、
フンの部分。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, today is the day we say goodbye to Nozomi-chan, but we're still being so stubborn. Hehe... I guess that's just how we are.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ったく、
今日でノゾミちゃんとお別れなのに、
締まらない子たちだね～
ふふ……
ま、
それがうちららしいか。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: True! Then let's do this again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
では改めて！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Everyone from the Alkes Alchemy Hall! Thank you so much for everything you've done for me until today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
【アルケス錬金堂】のみなさん！
今日までお世話になりました！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, Nozomi's life as an alchemist came to an end...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうしてノゾミの錬金術師としての生活は、
終わりを迎えたのであった──
